$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-cmcom-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `cmcom-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's CmComSmsClient. CM.com Business Messaging API v1.0 authenticates with a `X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` request header carrying the product token (a UUID). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (CM.com `/v1.0/message` accepted shape, a mock message id `MOCK-SMS-CMCOM-0001`) and isEnabled:true, so the dispatch leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT a CM.com product token — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned success body WITHOUT actually sending an SMS. To go live: paste your CM.com product token onto `configuration.headers.X-CM-PRODUCTTOKEN` and REMOVE `configuration.mock` (the production base URL is already set). The send leaf is admin-owned: the base URL is fixed on the source and only the message body/recipient travel in the POST body, so there is no SSRF surface. This source is OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST /v1.0/message) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).
